material_current_clarification.operational_eigenzeit: QIK-VRT Eigenzeit is first the receiver's monotonic local change time. A metric proper-time calibration is an additional physical worldline binding.
material_current_clarification.coordinate_future_boundary: For spacelike-separated comparisons, a source observer's local-present event may be assigned to another observer's coordinate future. This coordinate assignment is not a causal-future relation and does not provide a source-bound record before future-directed delivery.
material_current_clarification.negative_information_direction: For a record pair, receiver-local change time rises while provenance-bound source marks fall: delta tau_R > 0 and delta theta < 0.
